_doc: W1 L12-25 gap (cowir-main 26347): once the Rat King falls, each W1 overworld pool gains its own species re-levelled with the @L mark. Tier = count of dragons defeated. Every tier's top level must sit in [next boss - 2, next boss], with boss levels read from monsters.json by test_the_w1_map_grows_with_the_dragons.
